summary: Initializes a stream/resource object: validates a marker byte and a size, installs default alloc/free callback wrappers when empty, allocates a 24-byte internal buffer via the allocator callback, then configures signedness, bit-width exponent and a 1<<v6-sized resource table produced by sub_5276C5. On success resets the resource with ResourceResetWithCounter; on any failure cleans up through sub_5179A2 and returns a negative error code. Called from sub_517AC5.

local_names.a1: stream/resource receiver (callback slots and buffer pointer live here)
local_names.a2: requested size; sign selects signed/unsigned resource mode
local_names.v5: 24-byte buffer returned by the allocator callback
local_names.v6: magnitude of a2 after sign normalization

operations.description: Header validation: a3 null, *a3 not equal to 49, or a4 not equal to 56 fails with -6
Returns -6 when the marker guard fails
Returns -2 immediately when the receiver a1 is null
Clears this+0x18 (reset counter/state flag) unconditionally at entry
Guard on the allocator callback slot this+0x20 being zero (guard:0)
When the allocator slot was empty, installs DelegationWrapper_803a as default and clears this+0x28
When the free-callback slot this+0x24 is empty, installs FreeWrapper_9351 as default (packet guard:1)
Indirect allocator call: (this+0x20 callback)(this+0x28 context, 1, 24); the returned buffer is stored at this+0x1C
Guard on the allocation result; a null buffer falls through to the -4 error path
Initializes the buffer: clears the size field at buffer+20 and the signedness flag at buffer+12 to 0
When a2 is negative, stores its magnitude in v6 and sets the buffer signedness flag (buffer+12) to 1
Rejects out-of-range size: v6 outside 8..15 takes the cleanup-and--2 path
Writes the bit-width exponent v6 to buffer+16
Calls sub_5276C5(a1, ChecksumCRCComputation when unsigned else 0, 1<<v6) to build the resource table, stored at buffer+20
Guard on the resource-table pointer at buffer+20; null takes the -4 error path
On success calls ResourceResetWithCounter(a1) and returns 0
On any failure path calls sub_5179A2(a1) (cleanup) before returning the error code
Returns -2 (bad size), -4 (allocation/table failure) or -6 (bad marker) on failure paths
Invoked by sub_517AC5 as part of stream/resource construction
